head_commit.message:
feat: GraphQL-based shooter identification for trainer squad placement

Replace unsafe ssiFindParticipantInEvent (partial name matching) with
GraphQL-based squad competitor lookup for the signup SSI sync path.

Changes:
- Query squad competitors with shooter.id via GraphQL before/after registration
- Match by email first, then by cached shooter.id (no name matching)
- Before/after diff identifies new competitors on fresh registration
- Cache ssi_shooter_id and ssi_participant_id on staff_signups (M10 migration)
- DB helpers: updateStaffSignupSsiIds, getAccountSsiShooterId

Per MG-ID1/MG-ID2: eliminates name-based matching for state-changing
squad move operations. Withdrawal path still uses ssiFindParticipantInEvent
(to be addressed in follow-up).

head_commit.message:
fix: calendar dates off-by-one due to UTC timezone shift

Calendar grid was converting local Date objects to UTC via toISOString()
before extracting the date string, causing dates to shift back one day
in timezones east of UTC (e.g. Helsinki UTC+2/3).

Added localDateKey() helper that formats YYYY-MM-DD from local date
components (getFullYear/getMonth/getDate) instead of going through
UTC conversion. Applied to calendar grid generation and today highlight.
